Interwoven Rescue Lanes.name: Interwoven Rescue Lanes
Interwoven Rescue Lanes.description: The user divides their vines between three supported rescue slings within twenty meters, independently lowering one adult in each by up to five meters over two turns while keeping a clear path for rescuers. Clothing or blankets must cover skin against thorns. Every sling needs an intact anchored bundle, and the user stays braced and cannot attack; a severed support drops its load, and afterward neck strain prevents further lifting until rest. Strain: severe.
